# Project ids in their canonical, lower-case form: "ok <id>" or "bad <id>".
# The ProjectId schema in openapi.yaml is the definition (ADR 0018):
# contract.ValidProjectID, which the API and the CLI call, and the engine's
# layout guard validProjectSegment must agree with it on every line. Only
# lower-case ids belong here: the schema and the engine also accept upper case
# in org and repo, the CLI lower-cases first. The id is everything after the
# first space.
ok github.com/acme/widgets
ok gitlab.example.com/org_1/re-po.v2
ok h/a/b
ok h-1.example/a/b..c
ok 0.example/-a/_b
bad github.com/acme
bad github.com/acme/widgets/extra
bad .github.com/acme/widgets
bad github.com/.acme/widgets
bad github.com/acme/.widgets
bad github.com/../widgets
bad gh_x.example/acme/widgets
bad -x.com/acme/widgets
bad github.com/acme/wid%2fgets
bad github.com/acme/wid?gets
bad github.com/acme/wid#gets
bad github.com/acme/wid:gets
bad github.com/acme/wid@gets
bad github.com/ac me/widgets
bad github.com/acme/widgéts
bad github.com//widgets
bad /acme/widgets
bad github.com/acme/
